models.name: One Piece - Going Merry by Anex (Sketchfab)
models.license: CC BY 4.0 (author-tagged; underlying ship design is Toei/Shueisha IP a fan modeler cannot actually license)
models.quality_notes: 83.3k tris / 43.9k verts, Blender-made, 13k+ downloads, published 2015. Very likely the source of the existing 21MB goingMerry folder. Download requires free Sketchfab login (no anonymous curl/API).
models.use_for: Reference/baseline — if this is your current model, re-downloading gains nothing; compress what you have instead.

models.name: The Going Merry (One Piece) - Game Ready by Oliver Edwards (Sketchfab)
models.license: CC BY 4.0 (author-tagged fan art; same IP caveat)
models.quality_notes: Highest-quality free Going Merry found: 176.6k tris / 93.1k verts with 4 full PBR texture sets at 4096x4096 (diffuse/metallic/roughness/normal). Raw download will be far heavier than your current 21MB — only worth it if you gltf-transform it down (1K textures, meshopt) to ~3-5MB. Requires Sketchfab login.
models.use_for: Hero Going Merry upgrade IF you want better visuals and are willing to compress aggressively; otherwise skip.

models.name: Thousand Sunny Ship by Tigerar1 (Sketchfab)
models.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike clause — derivative scene assets arguably must stay BY-SA; same fan-art IP caveat)
models.quality_notes: 28.1k tris / 19.9k verts — much lighter than your 10MB Sunny, published Nov 2023, modern topology. Requires Sketchfab login.
models.use_for: Lightweight Thousand Sunny replacement if the current 10MB model compresses poorly.

models.name: THOUSAND SUNNY - ONE PIECE by ShacLaw (Sketchfab)
models.license: CC BY 4.0 (author-tagged fan art; same IP caveat)
models.quality_notes: 62.6k tris / 36.2k verts, from 2015, no texture documentation. Middle option; probably the source of your existing thusand_sunny folder. Requires Sketchfab login.
models.use_for: Baseline comparison only — nothing clearly better than what you have.

models.name: Kenney Pirate Kit
models.quality_notes: 70+ optimized low-poly assets: modular pirate ships (hulls, sails, cannons), palm trees, rocks, treasure, docks. Ships in separate FBX/OBJ/GLTF — GLTF works in three.js with zero conversion. Download button on kenney.nl needs no login; also on itch.io.
models.use_for: Island dressing (palms, rocks, docks, treasure chests) around your One Piece ships, plus background/NPC boats.

models.name: Quaternius Ships Pack
models.quality_notes: 6 simple low-poly ships (pirate/sail style) in FBX/OBJ/Blend; no login, direct download button. Also browsable per-model on poly.pizza (e.g. https://poly.pizza/m/cIzO4MBPqI Sail Ship).
models.use_for: Distant background ships on the horizon to make the ocean feel alive without extra MB.

models.name: Quaternius Ultimate Stylized Nature Pack
models.quality_notes: Stylized palm trees, pines, bushes, grass, flowers — textured, some animated; the toon look matches an anime ocean better than realistic assets. Bundle mirror: https://poly.pizza/bundle/Ultimate-Stylized-Nature-Pack-zyIyYd9yGr
models.use_for: Upgrading the 3MB low-poly islands with anime-styled vegetation.

models.name: Flying Seagull (Poly by Google, via Poly Pizza)
models.quality_notes: Low-poly flying seagull; Poly Pizza serves downloads without registration. Second option: https://poly.pizza/m/0WRzrtCIIRp. Tiny file, easy to instance and animate on a circular path.
models.use_for: Ambient seagulls circling the ships/islands — cheap atmosphere win.

hdris_textures.use_for: Primary daytime sky: bright midday, high-contrast, puffy clouds — closest match to the One Piece anime look. 4k variant verified at .../hdr/4k/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky_4k.hdr (20.7MB; use 2k for web). Page: https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky

hdris_textures.name: Aristea Wreck (Pure Sky) — Poly Haven HDRI
hdris_textures.use_for: Alternate day sky — captured over an ocean shipwreck, midday partly-cloudy, so the horizon lighting genuinely matches open sea. URL verified HTTP 200.

hdris_textures.name: Qwantani Sunset (Pure Sky) — Poly Haven HDRI
hdris_textures.use_for: Sunset mode / scene-transition sky: warm clear sunset, medium contrast. URL verified.

hdris_textures.name: Belfast Sunset (Pure Sky) — Poly Haven HDRI

hdris_textures.name: three.js waternormals.jpg (official ocean example texture)
hdris_textures.use_for: Drop-in normal map for THREE.Water / custom ocean shader — the exact texture the three.js ocean demo uses. Direct curl verified HTTP 200.

hdris_textures.use_for: Sea-foam detail around ship hulls and island shorelines. Direct download verified (302 to 8.7MB zip, no login). Browse page: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Foam001

hdris_textures.use_for: Animated caustics on shallow water near islands (also: 16-frame animated set at https://opengameart.org/content/water-caustics-effect-small, both CC0, files download without login).

recommendation: Keep and optimize the existing One Piece models — do not replace them with generic pirate ships. The Going Merry, Thousand Sunny, Moby Dick, and straw hat ARE the theme; swapping in Kenney/Quaternius ships would make it just another pirate portfolio, and nothing meaningfully better exists anyway: the best free Sketchfab alternatives are the same generation of fan models (Anex's 83k-tri Merry is almost certainly what you already have; Oliver Edwards' 176k-tri version is prettier but heavier and still needs the same compression pass). Licensing reality: all fan models carry author-tagged CC-BY, but a fan cannot license Toei/Shueisha's ship designs — acceptable risk for a personal non-commercial portfolio with visible Sketchfab attribution, not something a 'better model' fixes. The mandatory work is compression, and the numbers are worse than stated: goingMerry is 21MB, thusand_sunny 10MB, AND one_piece_straw_hat_2_years is 20MB (while an unused 144KB straw-hat.glb already sits in public/assets — use that instead). Run `npx @gltf-transform/cli optimize scene.gltf out.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024` on each folder-based scene.gltf; expect 21MB -> ~2-4MB and 10MB -> ~1-2MB, single-file .glb, faster parse. If the Sunny compresses poorly, Tigerar1's 28k-tri CC BY-SA model is the one worthwhile swap (note the ShareAlike clause). Then SUPPLEMENT with CC0 assets where authenticity doesn't matter: Kenney Pirate Kit + Quaternius Ultimate Stylized Nature for island palms/rocks/docks, Quaternius Ships as distant background sails, a Poly Pizza seagull instanced overhead, kloofendal_48d puresky (day) + qwantani/belfast sunset HDRIs (2k .hdr, ~3-6MB each) for the anime sky, three.js waternormals + ambientCG Foam001 + OpenGameArt caustics for the water. That combination keeps the One Piece identity, gets total 3D payload from ~57MB to well under 15MB, and everything supplemental is CC0/MIT and curl-able in CI.
